dedupe_keys.name: wtdigitwin wind turbine digital twin for virtual sensing of loads motions and wind from scada measurements nrel

description: wtDigiTwin is wind turbine digital twin software by Emmanuel Branlard of the National Renewable Energy Laboratory, released on Zenodo. It estimates loads, motions and environmental conditions of an operating turbine from SCADA measurements and a turbine model, so signals that are not measured can be predicted online from a few reliable measurements. It combines a linear state-space model, a wind speed estimator and a Kalman filter; the state-space model comes from OpenFAST linearisations or the bundled yams package. The current version gives examples estimating wind speed, thrust, torque, tower-top position and tower loads for onshore or offshore turbines from tower top acceleration, generator torque, pitch and rotational speed. The page lists uses such as real-time fatigue estimation of key components, root cause and failure detection, lifetime reassessment and better follow-on designs. Version 1.0 is a free zip under CC BY 4.0, published in June 2023. Coverage is not tied to a site. Caveats: the page does not state the language or give validation results, and it has not been updated since 2023. Simulation uses are virtual sensing of turbine loads for digital twins of wind assets and structural health under wind loading. Related records: model-energy-grid-sizing-toolbox-wind-nuclear-storage is another wind energy tool.
inputs: SCADA measurements such as tower top acceleration, generator torque, pitch and rotational speed
A linear state-space wind turbine model from OpenFAST linearisation or the yams package
